Google-входы и внутренний аккаунт: Google sign-in and your internal account
Один внутренний аккаунт GENESIS может им: One internal GENESIS account may have several verified Google sign-in methods. Their verified subject and canonical issuer, display email and name, active status, primary designation, verification time and security epoch distinguish these methods. Email alone does not prove ownership. Choosing a primary sign-in does not transfer Calendar, Tasks, store purchases or files. Prepared 3.2.2 identity management is disabled until separately activated.
Файл .genesisbackup шифруется на устройс: Each .genesisbackup file uses AES-256-GCM with a new random data key, wrapped using AES-256-KW under a separate random user backup key. Keep this key separate from the file and primary Google. Local file checks decrypt on the device; the backend does not receive this backup key. Authorized restore encrypts permitted data with existing section keys. Possession of both file and key permits reading its contents. GENESIS also uses account data keys available to its backend under the existing storage model and independent Physis protection; the entire service is not described as end-to-end encrypted. A server signature proves snapshot origin, not a current subscription. Financial evidence is absent in this implementation. Session/OAuth tokens, cookies, sign-in recovery codes, device private keys and payment secrets are excluded. Only format version, random backup ID, algorithms and technical encryption fields remain outside encryption.
Загруженный файл проверяется и расшифров: The file is checked and decrypted in device memory. Compressed archives and SQL dumps are rejected; embedded links are never fetched. Authentication and the current plan are checked before server preview. Prepared restore operations, already protected by ordinary section encryption, remain in encrypted server staging for at most 30 minutes until cleanup on the next operation or scheduled maintenance. Commit preserves a safety snapshot of current personal data. Restore never changes plan, identities, store purchase or roles. A separate data generation blocks old queues and holds them for review. Available Google task content becomes separate GENESIS tasks without writing back to Google.
Сроки копий, журналов и заявок: Retention of backups, logs and requests
Внутренние защитные копии устройства огр: Internal device safety storage keeps at most the two newest successfully saved snapshots within storage capacity. A new copy is saved before deleting an older one; the sole good copy is never deleted to make room. Clearing device data and signing out affect retention. The server keeps at most two safety snapshots per account within 64 MiB; scheduled maintenance removes snapshots older than 30 days except the most recent survivor. Downloaded user files remain under user control. Recovery requests last seven days; decision metadata and security events remain for up to 365 days or until account deletion. Encrypted revocation/notification jobs remain until delivery or manual error resolution; secret payloads are cleared on completion. Recovery codes are stored only as protected hashes until replacement, use or account deletion. Financial record retention is independent of user archives.
При потере всех способов входа новый Goo: After all sign-in methods are lost, a new Google receives a restricted recovery-request context. Processing covers the original internal account ID, verified new Google, evidence type, status, decision reason, times and security epoch. Independent ownership evidence and an administrator with a separate recovery permission are required; a file does not authorize sign-in. The review screen exposes verified metadata, not unrestricted private tasks, diary contents or keys. Decisions are audited. Self-approval and ordinary recovery of privileged administrators are prohibited. Pending requests do not disable working accounts. This prepared flow remains disabled until external Google authentication, notifications and responsible reviewers are verified.
Google Drive backup в подготовленной вер: Google Drive backup is disabled. No Drive OAuth or upload occurs until Google gives express prior written consent and the feature is separately activated. Such storage will require choosing its Google and granting its own permissions; changing primary sign-in does not transfer it. Revocation stops future operations without automatically deleting user files or downloaded copies. The local flow shows contents and processing purpose before use. Reading this notice, accepting terms, any necessary processing consent and OAuth permission are distinct actions. Declining backup leaves unrelated functionality available.
GENESIS-аккаунт определяется постоянным: A permanent internal ID identifies a GENESIS account. Any previously linked active Google opens that same account without import or administrator approval. Primary Google is a display and separately agreed contact designation; it does not transfer data, external connections or store purchases. Adding Google sign-in, managing it and connecting Calendar/Tasks are separate actions.
Обычный вход, восстановление доступа и в: Normal sign-in, recovery of access and recovery of personal data are independent. Use a linked Google when available. Losing all sign-ins can require independent ownership verification and administrator approval, without a mandatory archive. An authorized owner with active Standart+ can preview and restore personal data without administrator approval. A file, knowledge of an email or a payment screenshot alone does not grant access.
Владелец сохраняет одноразовый код входа: The owner retains a one-time recovery code or supplies sufficient evidence for a documented manual review. Reviewers may request more evidence or reject insufficient/conflicting evidence, an already owned Google or self-approval. Recovery is not guaranteed if all evidence is lost. Buying backup is not required for access-only recovery. Privileged administrators follow a separate process. File keys and sign-in recovery codes serve different purposes and are kept separately.
Копия устройства отражает доступные ему: A device snapshot reflects available personal data and pending changes at capture; a server snapshot contains synced information only. Check coverage and missing files. Choose supported sections, add missing data or confirm the displayed replacement of versions. A safety snapshot precedes application. Unsynced changes and old queues are not automatically sent after restore. Physis and shared projects retain independent access checks and apply flows; a client must not silently discard unsupported sections.
Восстановленные Google-задачи по умолчан: Recovered Google tasks default to separate GENESIS data with provenance. Writing back to Google requires an independently chosen explicit action and current permission; ordinary import does not do this. Google APIs may omit fields, recurrence, assignments or files and share no transaction with GENESIS. Historical financial file content does not extend a plan, reverse a refund or reassign a purchase. Changing Google sign-in does not transfer Google Play subscriptions, automatically create another subscription or cancel the existing one.
Пользователь хранит ключ расшифрования о: Keep a decryption key separate from its file and Google, protect it and check backup availability. Losing a key can make a file unreadable; disclosing both permits reading it. A sign-in recovery code does not replace a data key. A sole copy in an external Google may become unavailable with that Google, so retain an independent local copy. Disconnecting a service does not automatically delete user files.
GENESIS применяет описанные проверки цел: GENESIS applies the documented integrity, permission, conflict and safety checks without promising absolute preservation, exact background execution in a closed browser or continuous third-party availability. On failure, preserve the file and local data, avoid blindly repeating uncertain external operations and contact support with technical details excluding secrets. Applicable law and these terms determine obligations and liability; mandatory user rights remain. Material new processing purposes must be disclosed before operation, with necessary consents and OAuth requested separately from reading the terms.
